name: Shiritsu Tantei Max ~Sennyuu!! Nazo no Joshikou~
original_name: 私立探偵マックス ～潜入！！謎の女子校～
source:
Max is a private detective who is known - beside his investigative and combat skills - for his way with women. One day, he receives just the case he was hoping for: he has to travel to a remote space colony near the Sun - more precisely, to the women school in this colony. The principal of the school has committed suicide. Two agents that were sent to the colony disappeared under mysterious circumstances. It's time for Max to find out what's going on - an interesting side-quest to his main mission: have sex with as many girls as possible!

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/shiritsu-tantei-max-senny-nazo-no-joshik]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
马克斯是一名私家侦探。除了调查和战斗本领，他还以擅长讨女人欢心而闻名。一天，他终于接到梦寐以求的案件：前往太阳附近一座偏远的太空殖民地——更确切地说，是殖民地上的女子学校。学校校长已经自杀，先后派往殖民地的两名特工也离奇失踪。如今，马克斯必须查明那里究竟发生了什么。至于主线任务之外的有趣目标，则是尽可能与更多女孩做爱！

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/shiritsu-tantei-max-senny-nazo-no-joshik]Moby Games[/url]]
